coastal.title: Woman injured in bear attack in Whistler backcountry
coastal.description: A woman was taken to hospital on Friday after a bear attack in the backcountry near Whistler.

coastal.title: B.C. man who went missing in mountains for several days found alive
coastal.description: Stanislav Volo went for a hike on Sunday above the Sea-to-Sky Gondola and did not return home.

kamloops.title: Defoliated, moth-infested trees create fire concerns for Kamloops residents
kamloops.description: Some residents of Kamloops, B.C.'s Juniper Ridge area are concerned that trees defoliated by a needle-eating moth larva could prove to be a fire hazard.

kamloops.title: After an intense summer of wildfires, Lytton River Festival aims to bring life to the community
kamloops.description: The Village of Lytton is hosting its annual festival this year, with a special emphasis on cultural history of Chinese people and the village's legacy.

all.title: Wildland firefighters warned not to take supplements for smoke or PFAS exposure
